name: CERT.br (RSS and incident reporting)
operator: CERT.br / NIC.br (Nucleo de Informacao e Coordenacao do Ponto BR)
tier_rationale: Brazilian national CERT run by NIC.br (A8 definitions: national CERTs/CSIRTs are trusted); P298 records 'CERT.br and The Record trusted' and P345 is tier trusted.

reliability.justification: National CERT publishing its own advisories, statistics and notification guidance; feed items are headlines and links to its own publications.

rss.title: CERT.br RSS feed /rss/certbr-rss.xml

terms.quote: Licence (A1, legal floor): feed terms are 'unknown' until legal reviews them, so nothing runs yet in any profile. Legal's feed-reader decision (poll <= hourly; headline + link + date only; no full text; no redistribution) is recorded per kept feed with its class and evidence; a feed whose terms forbid business use or automated reading is dropped.

rss.notes: Quote: binding council text (P298 cond 3). Feed https://www.cert.br/rss/certbr-rss.xml (research C0754: verified, 14 items); poll <= hourly, headline + link + date only. For legal's review, observed 2026-11-26 on the evidence_url ('Termos de Uso'): CERT.br content is under Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 4.0 for informational (non-commercial) use and commercial use of the information is prohibited. Also observed: www.cert.br now redirects to cert.br, so the owning batch adds host cert.br by extension (and to its module hosts) before the feed can be read.

incident_reporting.title: CERT.br incident notification guidance (manual; Cc cert@cert.br on takedown notifications)

terms.quote: .br domains and BR-hosted IPs add CERT.br guidance (notify the source network, cert@cert.br in Cc).

incident_reporting.notes: Quote: binding council text (P345 cond 4). Class 'open' is the P345 chair-file class. Manual channel only: V3LUM never sends e-mail or submits forms; the takedown packet names cert@cert.br in Cc and follows the CERT.br 'Recomendacoes para Notificacoes de Incidentes de Seguranca' (evidence_url, v1.4).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G03-1, p2-G11-1: batches only extend it (cert_br__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Feed downloads carry no investigated value (P298: disclosure 'none'); the incident channel is manual. ttl 1 h keeps the feed poll at most hourly. No quota block: no published or observed figure.
